tasks.behavior: Walking skeleton: Next.js app with lint, typecheck, unit, build and browser checks all passing
acceptance: pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test and pnpm build pass
the Playwright suite starts the built app and passes on desktop and mobile projects

tasks.behavior: A pasted article URL is fetched safely and extracted into a clean, structured article
acceptance: Given a page with scripts, event handlers, javascript: links, lazy images, tracking pixels and <font> footnotes, when parsed, then unsafe markup is gone, lazy images have real src, 1x1 images are removed, and footnote markers stay in their paragraph
Given URLs for 127.0.0.1, ::1, localhost and private ranges, when fetched, then the result is blocked-host
Given the Paul Graham essay and 4 other real articles, when extracted, then each returns a title and body

tasks.behavior: Home link submission, reader route, error page with fallbacks, and paste-text reader
acceptance: Given the home page, when a URL is entered and Enter pressed, then the browser goes to /read?url=... and shows the result
Given a blocked URL, when read, then the page says Couldn't extract this article. and offers paste the article text
Given pasted text, when submitted, then it renders in the reader with reading time

tasks.behavior: Research-based typography and four accessible reading themes
acceptance: Given each of Light, Sepia, Soft and Dark, when the reader and settings panel are open, then axe reports no WCAG 2.2 A/AA violations
Given the reader at phone width, when rendered, then there is no horizontal scroll

tasks.behavior: Reading controls: settings panel, auto-hiding bar, focus mode and keyboard shortcuts
acceptance: Given the panel, when Sepia, Relaxed, Narrow and Extra large are chosen, then html data attributes change and the theme persists after navigating home
Given a long article, when scrolling down then up by more than 48px, then the top bar hides then returns
Given the reader on desktop, when pressing +, -, s, Esc, f, Esc, ?, then size changes back, the panel opens and closes with focus returned, focus mode toggles, and the shortcuts dialog opens
